_meta.purpose: Shared ground truth for how many photos a calendar layout needs for every printed page to have its own: pages (monthRange.count, 12 when unreadable) x photo windows per page (frames, at least 1); null for anything that is not a calendar. The editor's 'X of Y photos' banner, repeat picker and pre-submit notice use it (calendarPhotoSlots in frontend/nextjs/src/lib/calendar.ts); the webhook's qty_summary uses it (calendar_photo_slots in backend/django/services/order_qty.py).

cases.name: one month a page, one photo
no frames still needs one photo a page
a nonsense count means the classic 12
